Cycle reminders and tips from Kenaret
Kenaret has a reminder for you.
Your period may be coming soon.
If you usually need something particular in these days, it may help to get ready ahead of time and give your body room to rest.
Pay a little more attention to your body\'s needs today. Rest, water and the care that usually works for you can help. If your period started, remember to log it.
A new phase of your cycle
By estimate, you\'re probably in the follicular phase. Some people feel more energetic now; see how it is for you.
By estimate, your possible ovulation window has started. This isn\'t a certain date, and Kenaret isn\'t a method of contraception.
You\'re probably entering the days before your period. If you usually need more rest or care around now, make room for it.
Her period may be coming soon.
Today you could start with a simple question: Is there anything I can help with?
Today may be the first day of her period.
If you want to help, ask her what she needs instead of guessing.
A new phase of her cycle
By estimate, her period has probably ended. It could be a nice time to plan something together; ask what she\'d enjoy.
This is only an estimate and says nothing about how she feels. Ask her how her day is going.
Practical, non-judgmental help is often valuable now, like volunteering for small everyday tasks.
You decide what your partner can see. By default, only general cycle information is shared.
In this version, this information never leaves your phone.
Choose at least one item to share to create a pairing code.
Send this code to your partner to enter in Kenaret. It only contains your last period start, cycle and period length, and your sharing choices.
Kenaret has no server, so updates aren\'t automatic. After logging a new period or changing what you share, send the new code again.
The received information will be removed from this phone and related reminders cancelled.
Kenaret is a cycle tracker for couples. Instead of being for one person only, it helps both of you understand the cycle and support and communicate better at the right times.
Everyone experiences their cycle differently. Kenaret never blames anyone\'s behaviour on hormones; it\'s about awareness, respect and better communication.

Predictions are approximate. Kenaret is not a medical diagnostic tool or a method of contraception.
The information and predictions in this app are approximate and may differ for each person. This app is not a medical diagnostic tool or a method of contraception.
If you have severe, persistent or unusual symptoms, please talk to a doctor or health professional.
Kenaret doesn\'t diagnose anything and never suggests medication or doses. Suggestions are general and don\'t replace professional advice.

string-array.name: partner_do
string-array.item: Ask her if she needs anything.
If she\'s tired, give her room to rest.
If she\'s in pain, take it seriously.

string-array.name: partner_dont
string-array.item: Assuming she must be upset or irritable

string-array.name: privacy_points
string-array.item: You don\'t need an account or sign-in to use Kenaret.
Everything is stored only on this phone. Kenaret doesn\'t even have internet permission.
Your data is excluded from cloud backups and device-to-device transfers.
Symptoms and notes are never shared.
Notifications never show details on the lock screen.
You can erase all of your data at any time.
